Omitting the factor 1/||S||_h leads to an incorrect expression for (d/dr)(r dA_k/dr) = int_{C^S(r)} k dsigma_r instead of int_{C^S(r)} (k / ||S||_h) dsigma_r, which affects the subsequent inequality relating E_k(r) and A_k(r). Witness: dV = (dt / ||S||_h) dsigma_t, so d/dr(r dA_k/dr) = int_{C^S(r)} (k / ||S||_h) dsigma_r
